Before installing, you may want to (1) review the script contents yourself (they're short and readable) to confirm you are comfortable running it; (2) note the script runs commands under bash so ensure your environment uses a standard shell; (3) if you prefer extra caution, run it in a sandbox or container first. 'Benign' here means the package is internally consistent with its description — it does not mean it has been audited for bugs or supply-chain risks. If you need autonomous agent invocation, remember the agent could run the script automatically; that is expected behavior but keep it in mind.
